maddeler.e:
نغتنم (form VIII)
# نَغْتَنِمُ (naḡtanimu) /naɣ.ta.ni.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# نُغْتَنَمُ (nuḡtanamu) /nuɣ.ta.na.mu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# نَغْتَنِمَ (naḡtanima) /naɣ.ta.ni.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# نُغْتَنَمَ (nuḡtanama) /nuɣ.ta.na.ma/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
